critical_code_review_comments: search_analytics.py:97 — distinct('ip_hash') over public_search_logs is OK at current scale but will be expensive at >100k logs. Consider an aggregation count.
search_analytics.py:94 — created_at is ISO string compared lexicographically. Works (ISO-8601 sorts naturally) but losing tz normalization could bite later. Consider native datetime.
genius_analytics.py:94-96 — to_list(5000) may cap data on heavy windows. Consider streaming aggregation if assistant volume grows.

genius_analytics.py:109 — actions_clicked count uses base match {created_at:{$gte:cutoff}} on genius_action_clicks; click_rate is ratio over actions_surfaced (parsed from chat_messages content). Both windows are aligned by created_at and same cutoff. ✓

GuardianBot.jsx handleAction: POST /api/chat/action-click body shape matches backend ActionClickIn pydantic model (session_id, action_type, action_label, product_id). ✓
